customer_id.meaning: primary id of the guest or client profile (seed uuid or content hash)

name.meaning: full name of the guest or of the organisation contact, exactly as it appears on the profile

phone_number.meaning: primary phone number registered on the profile

email.meaning: email address registered on the profile, lower case

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth recorded on the profile from the guest's identity document

postal_code.format: 5-digit US ZIP code or Canadian postal code A1A 1A1
postal_code.meaning: postal code of the billing address on the profile

card_last4.meaning: last four digits of the payment card currently stored on the profile

profile_created_date.meaning: date the guest profile was first created

customer_type.meaning: whether the profile belongs to an individual traveller or to the named contact of a group, meeting or corporate client

organization_name.meaning: legal or trading name of the organisation an organization_contact represents; empty for individual guests

reservation_id.meaning: primary id of the room reservation (one reservation = one room)

customer_id.meaning: guest who holds the reservation (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: rate plan the reservation was booked under, written as the official rate plan name

status.meaning: reservation lifecycle state (basis defined in the Room Reservations charter lifecycle)

confirmation_number.meaning: confirmation number issued to the guest when the reservation was booked

property_code.meaning: code of the hotel the reservation is for

property_brand.meaning: brand of the hotel the reservation is for, as recorded at booking

award_category.meaning: Ashbury Rewards award category of the hotel at the time of booking

award_season.meaning: award pricing season the hotel's calendar assigned to the arrival night, recorded at booking

nights.meaning: number of nights between arrival_date and departure_date

adults.meaning: number of adults registered in the room

nightly_rate.meaning: room rate per night before tax; 0.00 on Reward Night Rate reservations

tax_rate_pct.meaning: combined room and occupancy tax rate of the hotel applied to room charges

booking_channel.meaning: channel through which the reservation was booked

guarantee_type.meaning: how the reservation is guaranteed or paid ahead of arrival

loyalty_member_id.meaning: Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation for credit (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships); empty when none

group_block_id.meaning: group block the reservation picks up (foreign key -> group_blocks); empty for transient reservations

corporate_client_code.meaning: corporate client code quoted for a Corporate Negotiated Rate booking; empty otherwise

points_redeemed.meaning: total Ashbury Rewards points redeemed for the reservation's points-paid nights, including any fifth-night saving already deducted; 0 when none

certificate_nights.meaning: number of nights on the reservation paid with Free Night Awards; 0 when none

cancelled_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now(), read as hotel local time
cancelled_at.meaning: moment the cancellation was recorded; empty while not cancelled

cancellation_timing.meaning: whether the cancellation was recorded on or before the effective cancellation deadline; not_cancelled until a cancellation is recorded

no_show_date.meaning: hotel business date on which the reservation was marked a no-show; empty otherwise

relocated_date.meaning: date the hotel relocated (walked) the guest to another hotel because it could not honour the reservation; empty otherwise

actual_check_in_date.meaning: date the guest actually checked in; empty before check-in

actual_check_out_date.meaning: date the guest actually checked out; empty before check-out

rate_guarantee_date.meaning: date a Best Rate Guarantee adjustment was applied to the nightly rate; empty when never applied

charge_id.meaning: primary id of the reservation charge or deposit entry

reservation_id.meaning: reservation the entry belongs to (foreign key -> booking_reservations)

customer_id.meaning: guest the entry belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the Room Reservations charter

amount.meaning: amount of the entry; the direction (collected, refunded, forfeited, charged, reversed) is given by event_type

settlement_source.meaning: where the money moved: the card on file, or the advance deposit the hotel holds for the reservation

related_charge_id.meaning: the earlier entry this entry refunds, forfeits, transfers or reverses (foreign key -> booking_charges); empty on original collections and penalties

reversal_reason.meaning: reason a penalty was reversed; not_applicable on every other entry

folio_id.meaning: primary id of the guest folio (the bill of one stay)

customer_id.meaning: guest the folio belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

reservation_id.meaning: reservation whose stay the folio bills (foreign key -> booking_reservations)

variant_name.meaning: brand of the hotel where the stay took place, written as the official brand name

status.meaning: folio lifecycle state (basis defined in the Guest Folios charter lifecycle)

folio_number.meaning: folio number printed on the guest bill

property_code.meaning: code of the hotel that issued the folio

opened_date.meaning: date the folio was opened at check-in

settled_date.meaning: date the folio was most recently settled; empty while open

check_out_time.meaning: clock time at which the guest checked out and the folio was settled at departure; empty while the guest is in house

loyalty_member_id.meaning: Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships); empty when none

balance_due.format: USD, 2 decimal places; negative means a credit owed to the guest
balance_due.meaning: current balance of the folio, identically the sum of folio charges and refunds minus payments, adjustments and benefit credits

posting_id.meaning: primary id of the folio line

folio_id.meaning: folio the line is posted to (foreign key -> folio_accounts)

customer_id.meaning: guest the line belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the Guest Folios charter

charge_code.meaning: transaction code of the line; an adjustment carries the charge code of the line it corrects

amount.meaning: amount of the line; whether it increases or decreases the balance is given by event_type

business_date.meaning: hotel business date the charge belongs to (the stay night for room, tax and resort fee lines)

posted_date.meaning: calendar date the line was actually posted

posting_sequence.meaning: folio line number printed on the bill for lines posted by the hotel; 0 for lines posted by guest services, which are identified by related_posting_id

related_posting_id.meaning: the original folio line this line corrects, offsets or refunds (foreign key -> folio_postings); empty on original lines

adjustment_reason.meaning: reason code of an adjustment or benefit credit; not_applicable on every other line

dispute_id.meaning: primary id of the billing dispute referred to the hotel

customer_id.meaning: guest raising the dispute (foreign key -> customers)

folio_id.meaning: folio the disputed line is on (foreign key -> folio_accounts)

posting_id.meaning: the single disputed folio line (foreign key -> folio_postings)

dispute_reason.meaning: reason code the guest's dispute was registered under

disputed_amount.meaning: amount of the correction requested from the hotel

status.meaning: status of the referral; referred_to_property when registered by guest services, upheld or declined after the hotel's finance review

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

loyalty_member_id.meaning: primary id of the Ashbury Rewards membership

customer_id.meaning: member who owns the account (foreign key -> customers)

member_number.meaning: Ashbury Rewards member number printed on the member card

variant_name.meaning: elite tier currently held, written as the official tier name

status.meaning: membership lifecycle state (basis defined in the Ashbury Rewards charter lifecycle)

closed_date.meaning: date the membership was closed; empty while not closed

status_valid_through.meaning: last day the current elite tier is guaranteed; empty for Ashbury Rewards Member

tier_effective_date.meaning: date on which the current elite tier took effect (enrolment date for members who never changed tier)

cobrand_card.meaning: Ashbury Rewards co-brand credit card linked to the membership, as reported by the issuing bank

points_balance.meaning: current points balance, identically the sum of points credited minus points debited on the account

elite_night_credits.meaning: elite night credits accrued in the current calendar year, identically the sum of night credits minus reversals and the year-end reset

transaction_id.meaning: primary id of the points or night-credit transaction

loyalty_member_id.meaning: membership the transaction posts to (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships)

customer_id.meaning: member the transaction belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the Ashbury Rewards charter

points.format: integer points, always positive; 0 on night-credit transactions
points.meaning: number of points moved; credit or debit is given by event_type

nights.format: integer nights, always positive; 0 on points transactions
nights.meaning: number of elite night credits moved; credit or debit is given by event_type

reservation_id.meaning: stay or award reservation the transaction relates to (foreign key -> booking_reservations); empty when none

certificate_id.meaning: Free Night Award a top-off or top-off refund relates to (foreign key -> free_night_certificates); empty otherwise

eligible_spend_usd.meaning: qualifying spend the earning was computed on; 0.00 where no spend is involved

purchase_amount_usd.meaning: price charged to the member for purchased points; 0.00 otherwise

counterparty_member_id.meaning: the other membership of a points transfer (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships); empty otherwise

related_transaction_id.meaning: the earlier transaction this one reverses, refunds or mirrors (foreign key -> loyalty_transactions); empty on originals

promotion_code.format: upper-case letters and digits, up to 10 characters
promotion_code.meaning: code of the registered promotion a promotion bonus was earned under; empty otherwise

certificate_id.meaning: primary id of the Free Night Award

customer_id.meaning: member the award was issued to (foreign key -> customers)

loyalty_member_id.meaning: membership the award sits in (foreign key -> loyalty_memberships)

variant_name.meaning: award type, written as the official award name

status.meaning: award lifecycle state (basis defined in the Free Night Awards charter lifecycle)

certificate_number.meaning: award number shown in the member's account

issue_source.meaning: business reason the award was issued

issued_date.meaning: date the award was deposited into the account

expiry_date.meaning: last date on which a stay night covered by the award may fall

reservation_id.meaning: reservation the award is applied to, was redeemed or forfeited on, or was last released from (foreign key -> booking_reservations); read together with status; empty while never applied

night_date.meaning: stay night the award covers, covered, or last covered before release; read together with status; empty while never applied

top_off_points.meaning: points added to the award for the night it is or was last applied to; 0 when none

replaced_certificate_id.meaning: earlier award this award reissues (foreign key -> free_night_certificates); empty on originally issued awards

closed_date.meaning: date the award was redeemed, expired or forfeited; empty while issued or applied

activity_id.meaning: primary id of the award activity record

certificate_id.meaning: award the activity concerns (foreign key -> free_night_certificates)

customer_id.meaning: member the award belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the Free Night Awards charter

reservation_id.meaning: reservation the activity concerns (foreign key -> booking_reservations)

award_points_price.meaning: standard-room points price of that night under the award chart, recorded when the award was placed on hold

top_off_points.meaning: top-off points involved in the activity; 0 when none

group_block_id.meaning: primary id of the group room block contract

customer_id.meaning: organiser who signed or is to sign the contract (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: group segment the block is contracted under, written as the official block type name

status.meaning: block lifecycle state (basis defined in the Group Room Blocks charter lifecycle)

group_code.meaning: booking code attendees quote to book inside the block

group_name.meaning: name of the group or event as written on the contract

property_code.meaning: code of the hotel holding the block

property_brand.meaning: brand of the hotel holding the block

departure_date.meaning: departure date after the last night of the block

proposal_date.meaning: date group sales issued the block proposal to the organiser; the option period runs from it

peak_night_rooms.meaning: rooms contracted on the block's busiest night

contracted_room_nights.meaning: total room nights the organiser committed to in the signed contract and signed addenda; the attrition and cancellation basis

held_room_nights.meaning: room nights currently held out of inventory for the group, identically the sum of allocations and increases minus releases and reductions

group_rate.meaning: contracted room rate per night before tax

tax_rate_pct.meaning: combined room and occupancy tax rate of the hotel

cutoff_date.meaning: date after which unreserved block rooms are released to general inventory

contract_signed_date.meaning: date the organiser signed the contract; empty while tentative

cancelled_date.meaning: date the contract was cancelled; empty otherwise

deposit_held.meaning: group deposit currently held, identically deposits received minus deposits refunded, applied and forfeited

master_balance.meaning: balance owed on the group master account, identically master charges minus comp credits and payments

group_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the group ledger entry

group_block_id.meaning: block the entry belongs to (foreign key -> group_blocks)

customer_id.meaning: organiser the entry belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the Group Room Blocks charter

amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; 0.00 on room-night entries
amount.meaning: money moved by the entry; direction is given by event_type

room_nights.format: integer room nights, always positive; 0 on purely monetary entries
room_nights.meaning: room nights moved or assessed by the entry

related_entry_id.meaning: earlier entry this entry refunds, applies or offsets (foreign key -> group_ledger); empty on originals

amendment_id.meaning: signed addendum the entry implements (foreign key -> group_amendments); empty otherwise
primary id of the contract addendum request

customer_id.meaning: organiser who must sign the addendum (foreign key -> customers)

group_block_id.meaning: block the addendum amends (foreign key -> group_blocks)

amendment_type.meaning: kind of change the addendum makes

requested_room_nights.meaning: room nights added or removed by the addendum

status.meaning: pending_signature when issued, signed once the organiser signs, withdrawn if abandoned

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

meeting_contract_id.meaning: primary id of the meeting or banquet event contract

customer_id.meaning: client contact who signed or is to sign the contract (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: event package contracted, written as the official package name

status.meaning: event contract lifecycle state (basis defined in the Meetings & Events charter lifecycle)

event_name.meaning: name of the event as written on the contract

property_code.meaning: code of the hotel hosting the event

proposal_date.meaning: date the catering sales office issued the event proposal; the option period runs from it

contracted_attendance.meaning: expected attendance stated in the signed contract

guaranteed_attendance.meaning: final guaranteed attendance given by the client; 0 until given

actual_attendance.meaning: attendance counted by the banquet captain on the day; 0 until the event is held

tax_rate_pct.meaning: sales tax rate of the hotel's jurisdiction applied to taxable event charges

group_block_id.meaning: group room block contracted alongside the event (foreign key -> group_blocks); empty when none

contract_signed_date.meaning: date the client signed the contract; empty while tentative

cancelled_date.meaning: date the contract was cancelled; empty otherwise

deposit_held.meaning: event deposit currently held, identically deposits received minus deposits refunded, applied and forfeited

balance_due.meaning: amount owed on the event account, identically event charges minus payments and applied deposits

meeting_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the event ledger entry

meeting_contract_id.meaning: event contract the entry belongs to (foreign key -> meeting_contracts)

customer_id.meaning: client the entry belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the Meetings & Events charter

amount.meaning: money moved by the entry; direction is given by event_type

quantity.format: integer units (persons, hours, bottles, bartenders); 0 when not counted
quantity.meaning: count the amount was computed on

charge_component.meaning: component of the event bill the entry represents

related_entry_id.meaning: earlier entry this entry refunds, applies or is charged on (foreign key -> meeting_ledger); empty on originals

club_membership_id.meaning: primary id of the resort club membership

customer_id.meaning: primary member who holds the membership (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: membership level held, written as the official membership name

status.meaning: membership lifecycle state (basis defined in the Resort Club Memberships charter lifecycle)

membership_number.meaning: membership number printed on the club card

property_code.meaning: code of the resort whose club the membership belongs to

start_date.meaning: date the membership became active; empty while pending

family_members.meaning: number of dependants registered on the membership besides the primary member

freeze_start_date.meaning: first day of the current or most recent freeze; empty when never frozen

freeze_end_date.meaning: last day of the current or most recent freeze; empty when never frozen

notice_date.meaning: date the member's signed cancellation notice took effect as received; empty otherwise

termination_date.meaning: date the membership ended; empty while not terminated

dues_balance.meaning: amount owed on the membership, identically charges invoiced minus payments and credits

guest_passes_remaining.meaning: guest passes left in the current membership year, identically allocations minus passes used and lapsed

club_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the club ledger entry

club_membership_id.meaning: membership the entry belongs to (foreign key -> club_memberships)

customer_id.meaning: member the entry belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the Resort Club Memberships charter

amount.format: USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; 0.00 on guest-pass entries
amount.meaning: money moved by the entry; direction is given by event_type

passes.format: integer passes, always positive; 0 on monetary entries
passes.meaning: guest passes moved by the entry

billing_period.meaning: dues period or membership year the entry belongs to

related_entry_id.meaning: earlier entry this entry pays, credits or relates to (foreign key -> club_ledger); empty on originals

guest_name.meaning: name of the guest admitted on a guest pass or guest fee, as given at the club desk; empty otherwise

facility.meaning: club facility a guest was admitted to, or where a member charge was incurred; not_applicable on billing entries

charge_category.meaning: category of a member charge signed to the club account; not_applicable on every other entry

list_price_usd.meaning: outlet price before the member discount, on member charges; 0.00 otherwise

charge_reference.format: outlet check number, up to 8 digits
charge_reference.meaning: check number of the outlet sale a member charge comes from; empty on every other entry

notice_id.meaning: primary id of the membership notice

customer_id.meaning: member giving the notice (foreign key -> customers)

club_membership_id.meaning: membership the notice concerns (foreign key -> club_memberships)

status.meaning: awaiting_signature when prepared by the desk, signed once the member signs it, withdrawn if abandoned

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record (one per customer)

customer_id.meaning: customer being verified (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether verification passed in this contact (monotonically non-decreasing)

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human handoff record

customer_id.meaning: customer handed over (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
